correctness.rationale: The substitution a↦aca,b↦d,c↦b,d↦c yields a at even positions and the c,b,d cycle indexed by ν₂(n+1) for odd positions, established by finite-word induction. The uniquely ergodic bilateral hull is measurably the dyadic odometer, so Fourier–Bohr coefficients are Haar integrals of this valuation observable. An order-2^r odd character integrates to 0 on valuation shells k<=r-2, to -2^-r when k=r-1, and to 2^(-k-1) for k>=r. The resulting exact amplitudes are M at integers, V/2 at 1/2, and 2^-r times P,Q,R depending on r≡2,0,1 mod3, with P+Q+R=0. Dyadic characters span L² of the odometer, so the full diffraction is pure point and the formulas cover all peaks, not just sampled frequencies. The displayed linear coordinate map (M,V,P,Q)↔(A,B,C,D) is invertible; if real P+Q+R=Pʹ+Qʹ+Rʹ=0 and coordinate absolute values agree, the triples differ by one global sign, including zero cases. Hence independent signs on M,V,common (P,Q) give all homometric real weights and 2^{#nonzero groups} fiber size. Independently verified exact inverse, Parseval and all eight real/four positive variants using rational arithmetic. Finite Fourier sums are corroborative only.
